label: Precipitation
text: 4.30 mm fell today across 11 hours, none of it before 13:00 and most of it between 18:00 and 21:00 at 0.7–0.8 mm/h, easing to 0.20 mm/h at the reference hour; tomorrow is the wet one — 21.60 mm spread over all 24 hours at 98–100 % hourly probability, heaviest from 05:00 to 13:00 at 1.1–1.8 mm/h — with 7.90 mm still to come on Sunday.
flags: The 21.60 mm is one open-meteo model run; wttr.in gives 1.4 mm in tomorrow's midday slot and 0.9 mm overnight, an order of magnitude apart on totals rather than a rounding difference.
